value.rationale: It completely classifies when the planner-preferred action pattern is individually unstable on the smallest frustrated (nonbipartite) binary anti-coordination network, and gives a sharp, natural iid uniform incidence of 1/4. This specifies precisely how often welfare and Nash clash under generic preference heterogeneity in a canonical microscopic benchmark for the source’s unrestricted graph-hardness questions. The continuous preference-region criterion and nonzero mismatch probability are not a change of notation or a known-table lookup.
